notes: All thresholds apply to actual native body poses, hinge states and real program completion.
The physical pose is never driven from an analytical equation.
Display-stage middle angles are compared by magnitude: 0, 60 and 90 degrees. The documented native signs come from the developmental cardinal-axis probe.
Any known importer warning must be added as an exact justified issue before final qualification, never silently filtered by a broad code category.
The final program must publish display stage only after its moves have completed and provide enough settled dwell samples. Movement stages may use other numbers.
The API-only probe is developmental and does not satisfy this actual-VM contract.
